title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12636)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12636) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12636). This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 4057 : 1986 'Information processing — Data interchange on 630 mm ( 0'25 in ) magnetic tape cartridge, 63 bpmm ( 1 600 bpi ) phaseencoded', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee ( LTDC 24 ) and approval of the Electronic and Telecommunication Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. b) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
